claims.statement: Tom Allen was a retired champion pugilist living in St. Louis in April 1903.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist in St. Louis, is planning to celebrate his sixty-fourth birthday April 23

claims.statement: Tom Allen planned to marry Mrs. Tillie Hartgrove of St. Louis on his 64th birthday, April 23; she is described as a 31-year-old (printed as '[3]1-year-old').
claims.excerpt: planning to celebrate his sixty-fourth birthday April 23, by taking unto himself a [3]1-year-old bride

claims.statement: Allen had been ill since last Christmas, from an illness from which he was now convalescing.
claims.excerpt: an illness which began last Christmas, and from which he is only now convalescing

notes: Age is printed '[3]1' (OCR); 198 gives Mrs. Hartgrove as about 31, so 31 is likely. Short wire-style item; the same news as 197.
